Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 36

“Arjuna said: Then what impels a person to commit wrong even against their own will, Varshneya, as if driven by force?”

Arjuna asks the question the whole chapter has been circling, and he asks it from experience. He knows the feeling of being pushed into what he did not choose.
